gates.detail: 5 USDG basket: EXECUTED/RECEIPT_VERIFIED; 100 USDG basket: EXECUTED/RECEIPT_VERIFIED
5 USDG: PRICE_POLICY_UNPROVEN (NO_REFERENCE_PRICE, POLICY_NOT_PROVEN); 100 USDG: PRICE_POLICY_UNPROVEN (NO_REFERENCE_PRICE, POLICY_NOT_PROVEN)

BagExecutionRouter executes whatever calldata/minimums the backend planSigner signs. A user-permissioned DCA needs target, token, selector, recipient, spend and value rules enforced on chain from the user permission; removing the signature without that would let anyone choose calldata.

DcaComposerPlan pins a Composer program template. A router-based plan variant with the same per-period budget, total budget, recipient binding, atomic delivery and SDK receipt evidence is not written.
The shadow run used ShadowBagFactory (a mock that reports every bagId as registered); a real BAG registry check is not exercised.
ShadowV4Adapter is a research helper with adversarial unit tests, not a reviewed production adapter.
